description: This file defines interfaces for a timer system, including the ITimer and ITimerFactory classes, as well as the TimerType enum. It provides abstract methods for creating, canceling, and checking the status of timers, intended for implementation elsewhere.

classes.name: ITimer
classes.description: Interface for timer objects, providing methods to cancel the timer and check if it is active.

classes.name: ITimerFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating ITimer instances.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Static method to obtain the singleton instance of ITimerFactory.

methods.name: createTimer
methods.description: Creates a new ITimer object with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently active.
